about_the_game:
Discover the hidden secrets of the base located on Mars and manage your own research projects in this entertaining and exciting adventure that combines logical puzzles with base and research management elements!

Gameplay :

Base Management and Development:
Lead and develop the Mars base to meet new challenges and opportunities! Make strategic decisions about the layout of the base infrastructure, optimization of energy supply, establishment of water and air systems, as well as the efficiency of food production and storage.

Research and Development:
Initiate your own research projects to discover new technologies and resources on the surface of Mars! Explore new areas, collect samples and data, and then use them to promote research and development and improve your base.

Creative Puzzles:
To progress during the mission, you'll need timing, creativity, and strategic thinking. The tasks are diverse and exciting, challenging your mind and problem-solving skills. Every moment counts during the mission, and success depends on your creativity and good decision-making.



Get ready for an exciting adventure where the combination of base management, research, and creative puzzles ensures an entertaining and enjoyable experience for players!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.3GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.7GHz or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
